nodes.label: Teacher Signal Aggregation with Abstention
nodes.rationale: Weighted mean, log-probability mean, or majority voting gated by agreement/confidence/entropy thresholds; abstention is preferred over emitting a low-quality soft label.

nodes.label: generate/annotate/train/evaluate/predict CLI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Each stage is a separate `python -m specialist_factory` subcommand driven by one config file, so expensive annotation is not re-run on every training experiment.

nodes.label: Separated Evaluation Metrics
nodes.rationale: Human-label accuracy, student/teacher agreement, and teacher abstention rate are reported separately so agreeing with a wrong teacher is not mistaken for accuracy.

nodes.label: Jev/ModernBERT Distillation Profile
nodes.rationale: Obtains real Jev `noul` class scores, caches the provenance-rich signals, and distills them into answerdotai/ModernBERT-base plus a Laya-inspired marker decision head; needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY (and optional TYPESAFE_BASE_URL) at annotation time.

nodes.label: Explicit Late Fusion for Multimodal Data
nodes.norm_label: explicit late fusion for multimodal data
nodes.rationale: Fusion is explicit and late so the text and image encoders stay independent and either modality can be absent at predict time.

nodes.label: Lightning Soft-label Distillation plus Human Cross Entropy
nodes.norm_label: lightning soft-label distillation plus human cross entropy
nodes.rationale: Combining teacher soft labels with human cross entropy lets scarce human labels anchor the student while abundant teacher signals supply the rest of the gradient.

nodes.label: OpenRouter VLM Adapter
nodes.rationale: Uses OpenRouter's documented /api/v1/chat/completions schema and JSON-object response format, requires an env key, and stores its confidence as self-reported.

nodes.label: Teacher Signal Provenance and Caching
nodes.rationale: Each cached signal stores model, source/version, latency, cost, signal type, and a request-derived cache key so paid/external annotation is auditable and re-runs hit the cache instead of the API.

nodes.label: Modality-neutral JSONL Sample Schema
nodes.rationale: One record shape (id, text, image, optional human_label, metadata) for all modalities so text, vision, and multimodal tasks reuse the same data path and CLI.

nodes.label: Small Local Student Models
nodes.rationale: Hashed-text and image-stat encoders with an MLP head stay CPU-cheap, keeping the POC runnable without accelerators.

nodes.label: Protocol-based Teacher Adapters
nodes.rationale: Adapters behind a protocol (BART MNLI, CLIP, OpenRouter VLM, deterministic mocks) let real models be swapped in for offline mocks without touching aggregation or student code.

nodes.label: Jev Demo Aggregation (thresholds disabled)
nodes.rationale: min_teacher_agreement and min_confidence are set to 0.0 because a single teacher can never disagree with itself, so abstention gating would drop every sample.

nodes.label: ecommerce_intent_jev_distillation Task
nodes.rationale: Reuses the text demo's four-class intent taxonomy but sources labels from the real Jev teacher instead of mocks.

nodes.label: Synthetic Human Label Generator (rate 1.0)
nodes.rationale: synthetic_human_label_rate 1.0 labels every sample so the profile has a full gold proxy to measure distillation against without real annotators.

nodes.label: jev Teacher (jev-1.13, systemone-noul-v1)
nodes.rationale: Only real (non-mock) teacher in the configs; reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment and is version-pinned to systemone-noul-v1 so cached signals stay attributable.

nodes.label: laya_style_marker_decision Head
nodes.rationale: Laya-inspired marker decision head is the only trained component when the encoder is frozen.

nodes.label: modernbert Student Encoder (answerdotai/ModernBERT-base, frozen)
nodes.rationale: freeze_encoder: true with max_length 256 keeps the run feasible on a CPU-only host; unfreezing requires accelerator memory.

nodes.label: data/modernbert_jev_teacher_cache.sqlite
nodes.rationale: Persisting real paid Jev signals is what makes repeated training runs free after a single annotate pass.

nodes.label: Jev Demo Training Settings (20 epochs, lr 1e-4, batch 4)
nodes.norm_label: jev demo training settings (20 epochs, lr 1e-4, batch 4)
nodes.rationale: Smaller batch and lower learning rate than the tiny-encoder demos because a transformer head on frozen features needs finer steps; still CPU with seed 17.

nodes.label: ecommerce_intent Text Task
nodes.rationale: Four-class intent taxonomy (order_status, cancel_order, refund, other) with an explicit `other` bucket so zero-shot teachers have a fallback label.

nodes.label: Text Demo Training Settings
nodes.rationale: alpha_human 1.0 / beta_teacher 1.0 with temperature 2.0 on a fixed seed 7 CPU run keeps the three demos directly comparable.

nodes.label: tiny_vision Student Encoder
nodes.rationale: Intentionally tiny image-statistic features (output_dim 16) to stay CPU-only; README flags this as a POC limit.

nodes.label: Specialist Factory (POC)
nodes.rationale: Teachers, aggregation, human labels, and student inference are intentionally kept separate so partially labeled text/image/image-text samples can be turned into specialist classifiers without coupling stages.

nodes.label: Frozen Encoder on CPU-only Host
nodes.rationale: The demo deliberately freezes the ModernBERT encoder and trains only the decision head on this CPU-only host; freeze_encoder: false is only safe with sufficient accelerator memory.

nodes.label: POC Limits and Deployment Caveats
nodes.rationale: Vertical POC, not production MLOps: image student features are intentionally tiny CPU features, API response schemas are provider-specific, and calibration plus held-out human evaluation are required before deployment.

nodes.label: self_reported_probability Signal Type
nodes.rationale: Kept as its own signal type and deliberately not treated as a calibrated likelihood, because an LLM/VLM stating its own confidence is not a probability.

nodes.label: vlm Teacher (openrouter_vision, commented)
nodes.rationale: Documented external adapter requiring OPENROUTER_API_KEY; left commented so the demo has no network or key dependency.

nodes.label: hf_text Teacher (facebook/bart-large-mnli, commented)
nodes.rationale: Documented as the production alternative to the mock text teachers; kept commented so the demo needs no model download.

nodes.label: mock_text_b Teacher (weight 0.9)
nodes.rationale: Second mock at weight 0.9 exists to exercise weighted aggregation and agreement thresholds with a non-uniform ensemble.

nodes.label: hf_vision Teacher (openai/clip-vit-base-patch32, commented)
nodes.rationale: CLIP zero-shot classifier is the documented production replacement for the mock vision teachers.

nodes.label: Deterministic Mock Teachers for Demos
nodes.rationale: Demos use deterministic mock teachers so the whole pipeline is CPU-only and reproducible with no model downloads or API keys; HF teacher configs are left commented for swap-in after installing .[hf].
